passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: The risks discussed below could have a material adverse effect, separately or in combination, on our business’s operating results, cash flows, liquidity, and financial condition. Investors should carefully consider these risks. 5.2.1 Risks Related to Our Business This section describes the most significant potential risks to our business. Our crude oil and natural gas reserve estimates involve some degree of uncertainty and may prove to be incorrect over time. Reserves estimates are prepared using generally accepted geological and engineering evaluation methods and procedures. Estimates are based on geological, topographical, and engineering facts. Actual reserves and production may vary materially from estimates shown in this annual report, and downward revisions in our reserve estimates could lead to lower future production which could affect our results of operations and financial condition. Hydrocarbon reserves presented in this annual report were calculated in accordance with SEC regulations. As required by those regulations, reserves were valued based on the unweighted average of closing prices for the first day of each month in the 12-month periods ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, as well as other conditions in existence at those dates. The average of closing prices of ICE Brent crude oil for the first day of each month in the 12-month periods was USD 83/Bl in 2023, USD 79.7/Bl in 2024, and USD 68.64/Bl in 2025. In 2025, the Company recognized an increase in oil and gas proven reserves of 2.7% as compared to 2024, to 1,944 mmboe in 2025 from 1,892.7 mmboe in 2024. For more information, see section Business Overview—Exploration and Production—Reserves . Furthermore, at least once a year, or more frequently if the circumstances require, the Company ascertains whether there are indicators of impairment to its assets or CGUs due to the difference between the carrying amount of such assets or CGUs against to their recoverable amounts, using reasonable assumptions, based on internal and external factors, which reflect market conditions. The recoverable amount is considered to be the higher of the fair value less costs of disposal and value in use, based on the free cash flow method, discounted at the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC). Whenever the recoverable amount of an asset or CGU is lower than its net carrying amount, such amount is reduced to its recovery amount, recognizing a loss for impairment as an expense in the consolidated statement of profit or loss. External and internal sources of information may indicate that an impairment loss recognized for an asset, other than goodwill, may no longer exist or may have decreased, in this case, the reversal is recognized as an impairment recovery in the consolidated statement of profit or loss. The 2025 impairment gains, net of non-current assets of COP 22,000 million, correspond to the net result of: ● Transport and logistics: impairment recovery of COP 344,000 million, mainly driven by a reduction in the discount rate, tariff updates resulting from adjustments to macroeconomic variables, and a decrease in projected costs. ● Exploration and production: impairment loss of COP

credit_strengths.text: Operating margin sits well above the energy sector median, reflecting the low-cost reserve base of this integrated crude and gas producer. Profitability has narrowed over the trend period but remains a genuine buffer against commodity price swings and supports internal cash generation.

Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds capital expenditure plus dividends, so the upstream and transport investment programme and the shareholder distribution are funded internally. Free cash flow covers dividends more than twice over, leaving residual capacity for debt reduction or acquisitions.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage both sit above the sector median and rose year on year, placing the issuer in a weaker position than energy peers. Net leverage is only marginally inside the next risk-band boundary, so a modest EBITDA decline or debt increase would push the profile lower.

Reserve estimates carry geological uncertainty and impairment testing depends on discount rates and price assumptions; the filing records both impairment recoveries in transport and logistics and an exploration and production impairment loss. Downward reserve revisions would reduce future production and pressure cash flow.

The debt note shows the book is heavily weighted to foreign currency bonds and syndicated loans, with only a small current portion and the bulk non-current. Refinancing therefore depends on continued access to international markets and is sensitive to exchange-rate moves.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is adequate in absolute terms but sits below the sector median and declined year on year, while EBITDA coverage is roughly half the peer median. Debt service is met, but the cushion against a rate or margin shock is thinner than for comparable producers.

Cash flow to debt improved sharply year on year yet remains below the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is in line with peers. The liquidity position is sound, with a current ratio above one and above the sector median, though it slipped slightly versus the prior year.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is intermediate, driven by leverage rather than cash flow, with the cash-flow tier stronger than the leverage tier. Headroom to the next leverage band is thin, so the credit view is stable but sensitive to EBITDA and debt movements.

Our judgement is that internal cash generation, a long-dated maturity profile and a modest current debt portion support servicing capacity through the cycle. The main watch items are above-median leverage, foreign currency refinancing exposure and reserve or impairment revisions that could erode the EBITDA base.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率遠高於能源行業中位數，反映這家綜合原油及天然氣生產商擁有低成本儲量基礎。盈利能力在趨勢期內有所收窄，但仍構成抵禦商品價格波動的實質緩衝，並支撐內部現金生成。
經營現金流穩健超過資本開支加股息，因此上游及運輸投資計劃與股東分派均由內部資金支持。自由現金流覆蓋股息超過兩倍，留有剩餘能力用於減債或收購。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿均高於行業中位數，並按年上升，使發行人處於較能源同業更弱的位置。淨槓桿僅略低於下一個風險區間邊界，因此EBITDA小幅下降或債務增加將把該狀況推低。
儲量估算存在地質不確定性，減值測試取決於折現率及價格假設；申報文件同時記錄了運輸及物流的減值撥回以及勘探與生產的減值虧損。儲量向下修正將減少未來產量並對現金流構成壓力。
債務附註顯示賬簿嚴重偏向外幣債券及銀團貸款，僅有小部分為流動部分，大部分為非流動。因此再融資取決於能否持續進入國際市場，並對匯率變動敏感。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋在絕對值上充足，但低於行業中位數並按年下降，而EBITDA覆蓋約為同業中位數的一半。債務償付得以滿足，但相對於同類生產商，抵禦利率或利潤率衝擊的緩衝較薄。
現金流對債務的比率按年大幅改善，但仍低於行業中位數，而自由現金流對債務的比率與同業一致。流動性狀況穩健，流動比率高於一且高於行業中位數，儘管較上一年略有下滑。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為中等，由槓桿而非現金流驅動，現金流層級強於槓桿層級。距下一個槓桿區間的餘量有限，因此信用觀點穩定但對EBITDA及債務變動敏感。
我們的判斷是，內部現金生成、長期限到期結構及少量流動債務部分支撐整個週期內的償付能力。主要關注事項為高於中位數的槓桿、外幣再融資敞口以及可能侵蝕EBITDA基礎的儲量或減值修正。
